import Foundation

/* outer /* nested */ still a comment */
@MainActor
struct Point: Equatable {
    var x: Int
    let y: Double = 1.5e3
}

#if DEBUG
let mode = "debug"
#endif

func greet(_ name: String?) async throws -> String {
    guard let name else { return "nobody" }
    let count = 0xFF + 0o17 + 0b1010 + 1_000
    let text = "Hello, \(name)! Count: \(count + 1)\n\u{1F600}"
    let raw = #"Raw "quoted" \n \#(name) stays"#
    let multi = """
        Multi-line \(name)
        """
    let numbers = [1, 2, 3].map { $0 * 2 }
    if #available(macOS 13, *) {
        print(text, raw, multi, numbers)
    }
    return text
}

let ok: Bool = true && !false || nil == nil
